design_declared_before_observation.meaning: Equivalent Q2 decision coordinates; release and explosion times are independent with fuse_delay=explosion-release.
design_declared_before_observation.interpretation: Exploratory deterministic scenarios for positive-performance and 95% retention windows; not empirical uncertainty bands.

claim_boundary: Supports decision-axis interpretation under a full-cylinder surface mesh. Endpoint-control diagnostics are descriptive only and are not generalized from Q1 to arbitrary controls; this is not global optimality or empirical reliability.
